clos.original_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in image and video processing, digital signal processing in time domain and frequency domain
clos.enriched_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in image and video processing, digital signal processing in time domain and frequency domain. The scope includes Basic Gray-Level Image Processing, Basic binary image processing, Image and Video Processing (Enhancement), Basic Linear Filtering with Application to Image Enhancement, Nonlinear Filtering for Image Analysis and Enhancement, Morphological Filtering for Image Enhancement and Feature Detection, Filtering in frequency domain, Spatial filtering and frequency domain filtering in noise reduction, Multichannel Image Recovery, Image and video analysis, Wavelet transform and other image transforms, and Image Noise Models (machine learning based Video analysis).

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration.
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration. The scope includes Basic Gray-Level Image Processing; Basic binary image processing; Image and Video Processing (Enhancement); Basic Linear Filtering with Application to Image Enhancement; Nonlinear Filtering for Image Analysis and Enhancement; Morphological Filtering for Image Enhancement and Feature Detection; Multichannel Image Recovery; Image and Video Acquisition; Image Scanning, Sampling, and Interpolation; Video Sampling and Interpolation; Image and Video Rendering and Assessment; and Perceptual Criteria for Image Quality Evaluation.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video. The scope includes Image compression, Wavelet Image Compression, Lossy Image Compression: JPEG and JPEG2000 Standards, Recovery Methods for Postprocessing of Compressed Images, Image compression based on machine learning/deep learning, Video compression, Basic Concepts and Techniques of Video Coding and the H.261 Standard, Interframe Subband/Wavelet Scalable Video Coding, Digital Video Transcoding, and MPEG-1 and MPEG-2 Video Standards.

clos.original_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image
clos.enriched_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image. The scope includes Image and Video segmentation, Clustering and superpixels based segmentation, Segmentation using graph cuts, The use of motion in segmentation, Statistical Methods for Image Segmentation, Video Segmentation, Adaptive and Neural Methods for Image Segmentation, and Machine learning/deep learning based segmentation.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis.
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis. The scope includes Machine learning based features, Object detection, Neural network and Deep learning based classifiers, and Deep convoluntional neural network based classifiers.
